name: Methodology rule: don't parrot drill defeatism
description: Don't parrot drill 'honest ceiling' / 'architecturally hybrid required' claims without exhausting substrate-only path inventory. Rule: no 'architectural constraint' claim without N-sweep + tier-hierarchy + multi-benchmark + full primitive inventory + adversarial probes ALL failing. User-flagged 4+ times today (CORE-PERIPHERY + LLM-only-for-NL + 96% irreducible + slipnet 0.42).

name: Methodology rule: literature is not oracle
description: Literature is reference + prior probability, NOT ground truth. When empirical substrate-self-eval diverges from literature predictions, investigate as DISCOVERY OPPORTUNITY not bug. Pair-rule with drill-defeatism. Applies to RTF k=60, HRR encoding, intent-router design, 13-category taxonomy. Surface divergence explicitly in bench reports + findings notes.

metadata.applies_when: designing or testing against literature default

name: Methodology rule: honest attribution (claim lift from mechanism not aggregate)
description: When claiming retrieval/measurement lift, attribute to the specific mechanism that delivered it, not aggregate score. Findings_04 caught the algebra-vec NET NEGATIVE because Layer 1 attribution decomposed the lift sources; the EMBEDDING_DRIFT lift in findings #3 came from refined descriptions + relations, NOT algebra-vec composite.

name: Methodology rule 6: Layer 1 attribution PROT
description: For any composite-encoding scheme in substrate-self-index, run Layer 1 attribution BEFORE claiming the new component delivers lift. Identifies whether new encoding helps, hurts, or is neutral. Prevents silent shipping of net-negative additions. LOCKED PROT 2026-06-11 after Findings_04 caught algebra-vec composite as NET NEGATIVE.

name: Methodology rule: lift > 2*SE for method validation
description: For method-rescue anchors (negres_*, rescue_*), verify LIFT > 2*SE, not just absolute threshold. LVH-274 caught struct-align with lift=0.001 noise-level despite passing 0.40 threshold; method actually adds nothing.

name: Methodology rule: benchmark must break the symmetry the mechanism breaks
description: When test distribution is closed under algebraic symmetry the mechanism targets (commutativity/associativity/idempotence), all architectures collapse to identical output and mechanism becomes unfalsifiable. Example: hendrycks symmetric multiplication -> all variants 0.048 IDENTICAL; SVAMP asymmetric ops -> perceptron 0.110->0.267 2.4x lift. Before committing test resources verify benchmark non-symmetric along mechanism's discriminating axis.

name: Methodology rule: when count_NB is current-best, try discriminative perceptron
description: When count_NB is current-best for a classification-style capability, transitioning to discriminative perceptron with richer features yields +0.299 avg lift (observed across 5 capabilities: intent_classification, code_algopattern, NER, MAWPS, MultiArith). Universal-lever pattern; cycle 232-234 universal-discriminative-weighting moment.

metadata.applies_when: capability has count_NB or count-features as current-best
